//Drought: The drought's roll (Documentation/Research/HarshWilds/events_stats.md sections 1c skeleton (a) and 3b, the drought DECISION). THE EVENT PATTERN phase 4 copies: a rolled SelfTriggeredAction arms a self-timed hidden effect stat whose status does the work; there is NO CT3 event card, because a CT3 card is a click-to-resolve announcement that holds game time while it is open and cannot carry a duration or a passive effect (events_stats.md section 1a, MEASURED from .decomp/). ALL GATES ARE StatChangeTrigger ENTRIES, never RequiredStatValues: an unresolved trigger stat never fires (fails closed) while an unresolved RequiredStatValues stat is skipped (fails open). Gate 1, hw_switch_drought {1,1}: with the [Threats] Drought switch off this can never fire. Gate 2, vanilla SeasonCounter_Summer (4a9284146ffc28242b1f591ac7f7541f) {1,2880}: summer only (0 in every other season). Gate 3, hw_stat_dryspell {HW_DROUGHT_DRYSPELL_TICKS = 384, 1344}: at least 4 days without rain since the last rain or the last drought (Tgr_HW_DrySpellHold holds the counter at 0 while a drought runs, so droughts do not chain). Gate 4, hw_stat_drought {0,0}: no drought is already running. Gate 5, vanilla Stat_Pk_5_18_Everrain (100c9042f7bc62a44a9dfb65e6472d1d) {0,0}: never for a character with the Everrain perk, whose flag cancels vanilla Tgr_Rainmaker's two No rain collections; with Clouds pinned at 0 every weather collection would then be cancelled, and the pick would fall to a uniform draw over all of them. RepeatOptions 0 (Repeat), ActionCooldown 96 and OncePerTick: one roll a game day while every gate holds; a Nothing pick counts as a firing, so it also starts the cooldown. Roll: Nothing (weight HW_DROUGHT_NOTHING_WEIGHT = 3, one card-less drop) against Drought (weight HW_DROUGHT_EVENT_WEIGHT = 1, one card-less drop too, since a collection with no potential drop gets weight 0 and could never be picked), so a 1 in 4 chance on each eligible day. The Drought collection's own StatModifications (vanilla Tgr_ForestBeastGoToPlayer and Tgr_Nightmare shape, applied only when that collection is picked) arm hw_stat_drought by HW_DROUGHT_TICKS = 672, its max; the stat does the rest and ends it at 0. Every number here is a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER, session-inferred and unmeasured against play, never balanced. UNMEASURED and load bearing: how often natural summer weather reaches a 4 day dry spell (harness check C3); if never, this never fires and the lever is the dry-spell threshold. INFERRED, harness check C1: that the collection-level StatWarpData resolves in a mod STA (no shipping mod used one before this file; WarpResolver walks struct array elements the same way as the StatChangeTrigger entries the eagle's live run measured).
